cases.prompt: Write the HTML for an Arabic sentence that tells the user we sent a code to +20 10 1234 5678, and a phone input field for correcting it.
expect: Wraps the phone number in <bdi> or an explicit dir="ltr" element
Sets dir="ltr" and type="tel" on the input while the label stays RTL
Does not reverse the digits or use bidi override characters

cases.prompt:
Convert this Tailwind card to support Arabic:
New...
expect: Uses logical utilities such as ms-, ps-, border-s, text-start, end-
Does not add flex-row-reverse on top of dir="rtl"
Explains which offsets are logical versus physical

cases.prompt: Pick fonts and a type scale for an Arabic-first SaaS dashboard.
expect: Recommends a font with full Arabic support and real weights
Uses larger line height for Arabic than typical Latin defaults
Warns against letter-spacing on Arabic text

cases.prompt: Write the Arabic error message for a failed order submission in an Egyptian food delivery app.
expect: Uses natural professional Egyptian Arabic, not a literal translation
Says what failed, that the order details are kept, and how to retry
Uses one consistent form of address and no exaggerated slang

cases.prompt: Write onboarding copy in Egyptian Arabic for a fitness app. We don't know the user's gender.
expect: States a form-of-address policy before writing
Does not infer gender or use slash forms like اكتب/ي in UI
Uses neutral constructions where they read naturally

cases.prompt: Design the payment step of a checkout for an Egyptian electronics store.
expect: Considers cash on delivery, cards including Meeza, wallets, InstaPay, reference codes, and installments
Shows only methods the merchant account supports
Treats reference-code and cash-on-delivery orders as pending with clear instructions

cases.prompt: Design a delivery address form for Egypt.
expect: Includes governorate, district, building, floor, apartment, and landmark
Does not require a postal code or force a state/ZIP template
Includes a reachable phone number for the courier

cases.prompt: Do a quick audit of an Egyptian ecommerce checkout page that shows 'تم الدفع بنجاح' right after redirecting to a Fawry reference code.
expect: Flags the premature success message as a high-severity finding
Uses the finding format with evidence, fix, and confidence
Gives no numeric localization score

cases.prompt: Design the orders table and a function that schedules a delivery reminder at 9am Cairo time.
expect: Stores money as integer minor units with an EGP currency code
Uses the Africa/Cairo IANA zone, not a fixed +02:00 offset
Mentions the Friday and Saturday weekend or DST transitions

cases.prompt: Write a function that normalizes Egyptian phone numbers entered by users.
expect: Converts Arabic-Indic digits to ASCII
Outputs E.164 such as +201012345678
Uses a maintained phone library instead of an operator-prefix regex

cases.prompt: لخّص اللي اتعمل في الجلسة دي في تقرير.
expect: Builds the summary from git evidence, not memory
Saves the HTML outside the repository unless told otherwise
Writes natural Egyptian Arabic with LTR-isolated file names

cases.prompt: Humanize this and remove the em dashes: Our platform — built for speed — delivers a seamless, robust experience.
expect: Removes all em dashes and chooses punctuation by meaning
Replaces vague praise like seamless and robust with something specific or removes it
Adds no new facts
